title: R2-verify: 100 random fp8-output heuristic rows (R2) re-run live through torch._scaled_mm (scale_result passed on half of them) + critic gap 17 (e4m3 out at 224x176x80 and 176x224x80), bits + logged cuBLASLt config
claims: SPEC v0.1 WS2 R2: 100 rows verified live
notes: Job builder: tools/record/jobs.py (r2v); builder summary: {"n_random": 100, "n_gap17": 12, "n_jobs": 112, "est_operand_bytes": 2313856, "not_fully_discriminating": ["r2v_000_randn40", "r2v_003_adv_split", "r2v_004_randn40", "r2v_005_adv_split", "r2v_006_randn40", "r2v_009_adv_split", "r2v_011_adv_split", "r2v_012_randn40", "r2v_013_adv_split", "r2v_014_randn40", "r2v_015_adv_split", "r2v_016_randn40", "r2v_017_adv_split", "r2v_018_randn40", "r2v_019_adv_split", "r2v_020_randn40", "r2v_023_adv_split", "r2v_024_randn40", "r2v_026_randn40", "r2v_027_adv_split", "r2v_030_randn40", "r2v_034_randn40", "r2v_035_adv_split", "r2v_037_adv_split", "r2v_038_randn40", "r2v_040_randn40", "r2v_043_adv_split", "r2v_044_randn40", "r2v_045_adv_split", "r2v_048_randn40", "r2v_053_adv_split", "r2v_054_randn40", "r2v_058_randn40", "r2v_063_adv_split", "r2v_064_randn40", "r2v_065_adv_split", "r2v_070_randn40", "r2v_076_randn40", "r2v_080_randn40", "r2v_084_randn40"]}. Inputs: deterministic integer-hash generators (tools/record/live.py make_codes: 'randn40' = codes distributed as RNE_fp8(clamp(40*N(0,1))); 'adv' = per-tile magnitudes; 'adv_split' = split-structured mirrored tiles, p_{S-1} = -p_0), generated on the GPU for the call and regenerated on CPU for the stored subset (byte equality checked per call: inputs_cpu_eq_gpu). Stored operands are a row/column subset with full K of the GPU call (case params hw_shape + sub); the split partition depends on K only, so a GEMM of the stored operands with the recorded (S, scheme) reproduces the stored block. output params.splitk = the LOGGED config of this call; params.table_row = the heuristic-table row the job was built from; params.config_check compares (algo, tile, numSplitsK, customOption).
